description: Block-form <match> wildcard catch-all (§18.0.1). A click sets @status = Status.Unknown, which has no named arm; the <_> wildcard body renders (data-arm="fallback"). The active arm is gone. Driven by a user click, not a banned state-set.
rationale: §18.0.1 a <match> with named arms + a <_> wildcard renders the wildcard body for any variant lacking a named arm. Unknown -> fallback, active arm absent. S478 open-Qs ruling item 13 (§18.0.1 amended S478): the dispatched arm renders in place of the `<match>`, with no wrapper element — the whole-tree `dom` no longer holds impl#1's match-mount `<div>`.
